verdict.rationale: Event-driven automation, such as alerts or actions on entity record changes, is a fair question for an online business filing portal, so the axis applies. The evidence shows no user-definable rules or triggered actions. The vote-by-mail ballot notifications are a fixed voter tracking feature, not configurable rule-based automation, and probes found no API or OpenAPI surface to build on.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
